authority: Explicit Agentique project authorization; strong operational corroboration, not final OMG adoption
selection: First eligible Feature in the normative ordered ownedMember projection of ownedMembership, preserving Element::ownedRelationship order
conformance: Exclusions include all metaclass subtypes, regardless of authored, implied or correction origin
incomplete_order: Incomplete; never select by element ID, record insertion order, UUID or map iteration
no_candidate: None; do not manufacture a cross Feature
dependent_semantics: Cross-feature derivation uses this selector; existing cross-subsetting, typing, featuring, specialization and redefinition obligations retain their own authority
mutation_scope: Semantic operation only; no source, library-content, descriptor, KERML11-8 or KERML11-145 change
